_about: Public-domain Theodor Christlieb (1833-1889, professor of practical theology at Bonn) in pre-1930 English translations, raw Internet Archive OCR: Modern Doubt and Christian Belief (tr. chiefly H. U. Weitbrecht, ed. T. L. Kingsbury; Clark, 1874), Homiletic: Lectures on Preaching (tr. C. H. Irwin, 1897), Protestant Foreign Missions (catalogued 1880; translator not named on the title page) and The Best Methods of Counteracting Modern Infidelity (an Evangelical Alliance paper, catalogued 1874). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
